import itertools

nums = list(range(1, 19))
target = 57

# find all subsets summing to target
subsets = []
for mask in range(1 << 18):
    s = 0
    # early break? not needed for 262k
    for i in range(18):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            s += nums[i]
    if s == target:
        subsets.append(mask)

print("Number of subsets:", len(subsets))

# find two disjoint subsets
found = False
for i in range(len(subsets)):
    a = subsets[i]
    for j in range(i+1, len(subsets)):
        b = subsets[j]
        if a & b == 0:
            c = ((1 << 18) - 1) ^ (a | b)
            # verify sum of c
            s_c = sum(nums[k] for k in range(18) if c & (1 << k))
            if s_c == target:
                print("Found!")
                print("Subset A mask:", bin(a))
                print("Subset B mask:", bin(b))
                print("Subset C mask:", bin(c))
                # build assignment list
                assign = [0]*18
                for k in range(18):
                    if a & (1 << k):
                        assign[k] = 0
                    elif b & (1 << k):
                        assign[k] = 1
                    else:
                        assign[k] = 2
                print("Assignment:", assign)
                # verify sums
                print("Sum0:", sum(nums[k] for k in range(18) if assign[k]==0))
                print("Sum1:", sum(nums[k] for k in range(18) if assign[k]==1))
                print("Sum2:", sum(nums[k] for k in range(18) if assign[k]==2))
                found = True
                break
    if found:
        break

if not found:
    print("No partition found")
